answer: Vouching bonds: a new identity can earn only after an existing member locks part of its own balance as a bond for it. If juries flag the newcomer as a duplicate, with near-identical answers to its unique per-identity challenge, the bond is slashed, a crystal-clear public penalty. An attacker must fund a separate bond for every fake, so a gale of a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand bonds plus fresh original work each round; even a juniper-scented rewrite of one text fails the copy filter.
